items.title: Home loan borrowers missing out on millions in offset savings
items.description: The corporate regulator has found Australian banks paid more than $55 million in compensation over a two year period for failing to properly apply mortgage offsets.

items.title: 'They are getting fooled': How ultra-processed food is made to look healthier
items.description: Industry insiders reveal how Australians are being deceived by marketing and labelling that makes ultra-processed foods appear healthier than they really are.

items.title: Live: National records tumble as Aussie sprinters storm to 100m medals
items.description: Lachlan Kennedy and Torrie Lewis set new national records in claiming 100m medals, while a host of Australians take gold across athletics and swimming. Follow live.

items.title: Ben Carroll begins first full day as Victorian premier
items.description: Victoria's new premier Ben Carroll will spend most of his first full day as state leader in Spring Street, with the Victorian Parliament in the middle of a sitting week.

items.title: Live: Search for survivors after Japan earthquake collapses shopping centre
items.description: Authorities are scouring the wreckage of a collapsed shopping centre southern Japan following a magnitude-7.1 earthquake. Follow live.

items.title: Angus Taylor likes to talk about systems. People are his 'kryptonite'
items.description: In an interview for Kitchen Cabinet, the opposition leader recalls feeling a sense of overwhelm and reverence for the parliament when first he took his seat there.

items.title: Trump airs frustration with Netanyahu before Oval Office meeting
items.description: In the latest sign of shaky relations between the war-entangled leaders, Donald Trump uses a TV interview to publicly express his frustration with Benjamin Netanyahu's apparent efforts to pressure him to keep attacking Iran.

items.title: 'Australia's Banksy' rape case witness wants the courts to hear this
items.description: A woman who accused street artist Anthony Lister of rape is speaking up to help others navigate the police and court systems. Lister was acquitted of all charges last year.

items.title: Underbelly of Victoria's Big Build to be exposed by royal commission
items.description: After toppling his boss yesterday, new Victorian Premier Ben Carroll used his first press conference to tell voters who he is not.

items.title: Live: Canavan says he would not have accepted trip after Hanson declaration
items.description: Matt Canavan says he would not have accepted a trip to Europe from a benefactor after Pauline Hanson declared Gina Rinehart paid for her trip to Italy. Follow live.

items.title: Search for missing baby to resume off SA coast amid community 'shock'
items.description: The search for a missing three-month-old in SA's South East will resume today, as police continue to investigate the circumstances surrounding the deaths of the boy's mother and sister. The tragedies have shocked the state and left locals stunned.

items.title: Warning social media giants might wear fines to help sink the age ban
items.description: In a damning submission, an age-check firm warns big fines may still be seen as a "small price to pay" if it allowed Australia's ban to "wrongly" be portrayed as a failure.

items.title: Australia supplants China as Pacific's biggest lender
items.description: Australia supplants China as the dominant lender and infrastructure investor across the Pacific as the government ploughs billions of dollars into the region through both foreign aid and loans.

items.title: Home for digital nomads in Malaysian 'ghost city' shut down
items.description: Malaysian authorities revoke the business licence of a US tech entrepreneur who was building a start-up community in a largely empty city.

items.title: Prehistoric 'murder scene' reveals 'unbelievable' triple-predator scenario
items.description: A prehistoric "crime scene" involving a marine reptile eating one of its flying cousins before being killed by the "T-rex of the ocean" has been uncovered in outback Queensland.

items.title: Quiz: 10 travel questions, now boarding at Gate 5
items.description: Which NSW town was the movie Babe filmed in? And where would you find the Atlas Mountains?

items.title: Australians are the villains in star-studded New Zealand spy comedy
items.description: What happens when you take the exciting world of spies and subterfuge to 1970s New Zealand? We talk to Paul Williams and Bret McKenzie about making their childhood fantasies come true in hilarious new comedy.

items.title: Hundreds of Queensland social housing tenants evicted after review
items.description: Dozens of households have been kicked out of social housing in Queensland after being found to own property or earn more than $80,000 a year.

items.title: The debate about the 'non-market sector' is confused, ABS official says
items.description: The "non-market sector" is not the same thing as "the public sector" or "the government", it's worth knowing the difference.

items.title: Brothers who kidnapped, menaced teen with chainsaw lashed by judge
items.description: A teenage boy was "terrified" during an assault by two brothers, during which he was kidnapped and menaced with a chainsaw in a shipping container in Tasmania in 2023.

items.title: 'Locals are fed up' as crime doubles in idyllic Victorian town
items.description: While the tiny town of Creswick sleeps, locals say criminals are roaming the streets in the knowledge police are a long way away.

items.title: Cards and gifts flood 99yo man as family posts social media call-out
items.description: When a social media appeal went out for birthday wishes, Cliff Kimlin's family never imagined it would bring rugby league legends Alfie Langer and Petero Civoniceva to the birthday celebrations.

items.title: 'Absolutely wild': Australian gymnasts top off Games with two more golds
items.description: Minutes after Breanna Scott wins balance beam gold for Australia at the Commonwealth Games, Jesse Moore claims the parallel bars title in Glasgow.

items.title: 'Very bad look': Brisbane defender given three-game ban
items.description: Gallop pleaded guilty at the AFL Tribunal on Tuesday night for what he described as retaliation on Mitch Georgiades after the Port Adelaide forward grabbed his broken thumb.

items.title: 'Not good enough': Dense breasts halting life-saving cancer diagnoses
items.description: When Kate Clark's breast started leaking fluid, she knew there was something wrong with her body. And although both a mammogram and ultrasound came back negative for breast cancer, she felt she knew her body better.
